name: Demandbase
tagline: Demandbase is an AI-powered ABM platform that combines account intelligence, advertising, and sales intelligence. Its AI identifies ideal customer profiles from first and third-party data, serves targeted ads to buying committees, and alerts sales reps when accounts show high purchase intent.
